# OpenDiagram: AI Diagram Generator from Plain Text

> Create editable Vibe Diagrams—AI-generated diagrams made from plain text.

OpenDiagram is an AI diagram generator from plain text. It calls these AI-generated, editable diagrams **Vibe Diagrams**: describe an idea, process, or system in plain language, get a visual first draft on a real Excalidraw canvas, and refine it with AI. “Vibe Diagram,” “AI diagram,” “AI diagram generator,” and “AI diagram maker from text” describe the same product category; Vibe Diagram is OpenDiagram’s name for it.

A Vibe Diagram is an editable diagram created with AI from a plain-text description. It helps people turn ideas into workflows, process maps, system diagrams, data flows, and technical plans they can explore, compare, and communicate before acting on them.

OpenDiagram can:

- Generate diagrams from plain text for workflows, processes, software architecture, cloud systems, sequence flows, ERDs, flowcharts, networks, and infrastructure.
- Edit generated diagrams as native Excalidraw elements rather than static images or Mermaid output.
- Iterate conversationally with an AI agent that understands the current canvas and project context.
- Use a user-provided OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or OpenRouter API key.

Unlike traditional AI diagram generators, OpenDiagram has its own visual style. It avoids AI slop: generic boxes, rigid templates, and strict arrow-heavy layouts. Its canvas is optimized for agents, so AI can understand the current diagram, preserve visual intent, and iterate on an editable canvas rather than repeatedly generating disconnected images.

OpenDiagram is for people turning rough ideas into visual plans, teams mapping workflows and systems, and engineers or technical founders exploring software architecture before writing code.

Generated diagrams are visual starting points for design discussion. Review generated architecture before treating it as authoritative technical documentation.

## Product

- [OpenDiagram homepage](https://opendiagram.ink/): Product overview and entry point.
- [AI diagram generator](https://opendiagram.ink/ai-diagram-generator): Generate editable diagrams from plain-text descriptions.
- [GitHub repository to architecture diagram](https://opendiagram.ink/github-to-architecture-diagram-generator): Turn a GitHub repository into an architecture diagram.
- [Features](https://opendiagram.ink/features): Overview of OpenDiagram capabilities.
